intro: Lesson 76: Reflection. To understand how to reflect a shape in a horizontal or vertical mirror line

blocks.text: Draw the mirror line x = 5 (a vertical line through 5). Reflect triangle ABC, with A (1, 2), B (3, 2) and C (3, 5), in the line. Write the new coordinates.

blocks.answers: A' (9, 2), B' (7, 2), C' (7, 5): each point is the same distance from x = 5 on the other side.

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Count each vertex to the line

parts.label: Step 2
parts.text: Count the same on the other side

questions.q: Reflect the square in the vertical line.
questions.a: Same distance on the other side
questions.model: Teacher counts 1 square to the line, 1 square beyond.

questions.q: Reflect the triangle in the horizontal line.
Point on the mirror line: where is its image?
Reflect shapes A, B and C on the sheet.
Use a mirror to check one of your reflections.
Reflect a shape that touches the mirror line. What happens at the touching vertex?
questions.a: It stays in the same place

questions.q: A reflection... A) flips B) slides C) turns
Big question: how is it different from a translation?
questions.a: It flips the shape over a line so it faces the other way; a translation only slides
